rows.name: disabled
rows.description: Whether the item is disabled and non-interactive.

rows.name: checkmarkIcon
rows.description: Icon displayed when item is selected. If it is not set the default icon will be used. Accepts an SVG React component

rows.name: selected
rows.description: Whether the item is currently selected.

rows.name: value
rows.description: The value associated with the dropdown item. This can be a string or any other data type relevant to the app logic.

rows.name: labelText
rows.description: The display text shown for the dropdown item.

rows.name: iconBefore
rows.description: Optional icon to display before the label text.
